default.name: assessment_create
default.description: Create a repeatable Quality Plan Assessment for an immutable evaluation subject digest.

default.name: assessment_create_successor
default.description: Create one immutable READY retry successor for a DECIDED, STALE, CANCELLED, or explicitly retried EVIDENCE_REVIEW assessment. The predecessor evidence and decision are never changed.

default.name: assessment_decide
default.description: Issue an AssessmentDecision for a reviewed Quality Plan Assessment with current requirement alignment.

default.name: assessment_diagnose
default.description: Read the current assessment readiness, runtime, and sealed-evidence diagnostic packet.

default.name: assessment_execution_authorization_issue
default.description: Exchange a compact Ed25519 host assertion for one target-bound credential execution grant. This operation never accepts UI issuance or credential values.

default.name: assessment_execution_authorization_revoke
default.description: Deny an unconsumed credential execution grant. Consumed grants cannot be revoked.

default.name: assessment_prepare_run
default.description: Resumably prepare approved validation bindings, environment, publication, Assessment, and managed execution without reconciling evidence or issuing a decision.

default.name: assessment_readiness
default.description: Read current assessment readiness blockers for scenario approval, published validation versions, and requirement alignment.

default.name: assessment_reconcile
default.description: Reconcile terminal runs into sealed evidence receipts and immutable assessment evidence sets.

default.name: assessment_review
default.description: Read the assessment review packet, alignment status, evidence hash, assurance observations, and decision blockers. Human-verification blocked evidence remains targetOutcome not_evaluated.

default.name: assessment_run
default.description: Run the published validation matrix owned by an existing reviewable assessment.

default.name: assessment_stop
default.description: Stop an in-flight assessment run while preserving partial sealed evidence receipts.

default.name: environment_ensure
default.description: Resolve an exact target environment or explicitly create an immutable proposal with allowCreate: true.

default.name: environment_list
default.description: List bounded target-scoped environment summaries; a current registry hash returns an unchanged receipt.

default.name: locator_ensure
default.description: Idempotently ensure one target-owned locator closure for a Quality Plan without browser interaction or credentials.

default.name: locator_graph_query
default.description: Query a bounded locator graph path within the target bound to a Quality Plan. fromId is required; omitted optional filters are normalized to absent.

default.name: locator_search
default.description: Search target- and Quality Plan-scoped locators by locator name, selector, group, module, or route before validation design.

default.name: operation_categories
default.description: List bounded canonical operation categories; known manifest hashes return unchanged.

default.name: operation_read
default.description: Read exact canonical operation descriptors and handler identities for selected references.

default.name: operation_search
default.description: Search the bounded canonical operation catalog with paired human Step naming. Provide a query or at least one filter.

default.name: project_add
default.description: Register either one local application workspace or one remote HTTP(S) black-box target. Local registration may initialize Git and write a non-blocking continuity marker; remote registration creates its initial environment without workspace access.

default.name: project_diagnostic
default.description: Unified agent preflight for application reachability, authentication, project identity, current-task MCP capabilities, target binding, Git reproducibility, and contract compatibility.

default.name: project_list
default.description: List application repositories attached to the local AppraiseJS hub.

default.name: requirements_analyze
default.description: Analyze the submitted source snapshot into a resolved requirement graph, queries, assumptions, and quality obligations.

default.name: requirements_answer_queries
default.description: Answer, defer with rationale, or accept requirement queries as assumptions; unresolved blocking queries prevent approval.

default.name: requirements_approve
default.description: Approve the resolved requirement graph and immutable QualityPlanRevision; blocking queries are rejected.

default.name: requirements_graph_read
default.description: Read the current requirement graph, quality obligations, approval state, and blocking queries.

default.name: requirements_submit_source
default.description: Submit an immutable source specification snapshot for Appraise-owned requirement analysis and Quality Plan revisioning.

default.name: step_definition_draft_read
default.description: Read one exact Step Definition draft and its separate reviewed-extension artifact.

default.name: step_search
default.description: Search ready Step Definitions by one actionable versioned identity. Results are paginated; limit defaults to 5 and cannot exceed 25.

default.name: test_run_diagnose
default.description: Diagnose invalid or suspicious managed test-run evidence with concise blockers and next action.

default.name: test_run_read
default.description: Read bounded status and evidence summary for a managed Appraise test run. A human-verification block is terminal and requires a fresh TestRun; it cannot be resumed.

default.name: test_run_start
default.description: Start an independent capsule-only TestRun from an exact published validation or target-owned authored suite/case selection. Independent runs never create Assessment evidence.

default.name: validation_compile
default.description: Compile approved scenario design with mechanical realization metadata into immutable realized validation versions.

default.name: validation_design_approve
default.description: Approve obligation-linked scenarios; mechanical selectors, runtime bindings, and locators are intentionally outside this review gate.

default.name: validation_design_propose
default.description: Propose obligation-linked behavioral scenarios, assertions, coverage, assurance, matrix intent, and limitations.

default.name: validation_publish
default.description: Publish realized validation versions using an expected compilation hash after mechanical bindings are resolved.
